propositions: Hand-authoring mapping config vocabulary and axis maps is transcription-error-prone; a read-only probe command must observe a live Jira project and emit a suggested [tool.rebar.mapping] block seeded with the project's real vocabulary and identity-seed maps.

The new verb suggest-mapping must probe Jira issue_types, statuses, link_types, priorities, and hierarchy via documented pycontribs jira.JIRA public methods, stub create_defaults for required fields not in the baseline, and surface partial transition hints as best-effort advisory data.

Serialization must preserve existing hand-edited flat [jira] and [tracker] config blocks and deep-merge under [mapping.projects.KEY], with existing keys winning, using a new orchestrator that splits the mapping table from flat config and emits both sections separately.
The --write option must target an existing rebar.toml via config discovery or create a new one at repo root, never editing pyproject.toml, and perform an atomic read-whole/mutate/replace operation.
The probe must be fully offline and read-only; all test cases use a fake port with canned data; live invocation is manual and never a CI gate.
